Cover one fixed-function, two-CU/four-lane/two-warp and four-CU/sixteen-lane/eight-warp host, queued DMA, two submissions, fresh VMs, capability bits, all-CU occupancy and complete reservation release. Prior 55-check packet covers unchanged spill/publication/fault/reset datapaths; it is not counted as new testing here.
